subject: Follow-up: SOC 2 posture, GDPR/HIPAA scope and breach-notification plan — next steps
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
To: Sree Patel <sree.patel@mediconix.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-09T14:12:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up: SOC 2 posture, GDPR/HIPAA scope and breach-notification plan — next steps

Hi Sree —

Great to meet earlier today. Quick recap + action items from our call so your security and procurement teams have what they need to continue diligence: 

1) Redwood posture overview (ask): we said we'd send a short summary of our SOC 2 Type II scope and encryption-at-rest/in-transit posture — attaching the summary PDF.

2) Regulatory scope question: you asked whether Redwood supports HIPAA-covered workloads and how we handle GDPR data subject requests for EU data processed via hosted deployments. Short answers: yes for HIPAA when on a Private deployment with Business Associate Agreement (we can provide standard BAA language), and we enforce data subject request workflows; I'll loop in Rishi for specifics on GDPR redaction/retention.

3) Incident response / breach-notification timeline: you requested our standard notification timelines and an example incident response playbook for tabletop use. Attached is our incident response playbook excerpt and an encryption attestation text file. Please let us know if you need additional forensics SLAs (RTO/RPO) or contact details for our on-call security lead.

4) Vendor security questionnaire: you mentioned a supplied VSQ (10–12 pages). If procurement sends the PDF/Doc (or a SecureForm link) we'll start populating. Can you confirm the email we should send the completed questionnaire to?

Next steps (proposed):
- Ava (me) to share attached artifacts and a short SOC 2 scope summary — done (attached).
- Mediconix to share the vendor security questionnaire + preferred security contact for technical follow-up.
- Redwood (Ben) to schedule a 30-minute technical deep-dive with your security team next week if needed.

If that aligns, I'll schedule the follow-up and include a lightweight mutual action plan in HubSpot so we can track target dates.

Best,
Ava Chen
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ava_chen@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0132

Attachments:
- redwood_soc2_summary.pdf (pdf)
- redwood_incident_response_playbook.pdf (pdf)
- redwood_encryption_attestation.txt (txt)
From: Sree Patel <sree.patel@mediconix.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
Cc: Mediconix Security <security@mediconix.com>, Procurement <procurement@mediconix.com>
Date: 2026-09-09T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: SOC 2 posture, GDPR/HIPAA scope and breach-notification plan — next steps

Hi Ava —

Thanks for the clear recap and for sending the artifacts. I reviewed the SOC 2 summary and the playbook excerpt; helpful. A couple of quick items from our side: 

- Procurement will email the vendor security questionnaire to procurement@mediconix.com by EOD tomorrow. Please populate and return — we prefer a PDF back with comments.
- Our security lead is Anika Rao (anika.rao@mediconix.com); please copy her for any technical clarifications.
- For HIPAA, we will need a signed BAA before moving PHI to any external environment; we understand that Private deployments are recommended.
- Incident notification timelines: our compliance requires initial notification within 72 hours of detection with a follow-up for confirmed incidents. Can you confirm Redwood's maximum time-to-notify and whether you provide a post-incident forensic packet?

We'd like to set a technical deep-dive with your security engineer next week on Tuesday or Wednesday afternoon (US Pacific). Either day works; please propose times.

Best,
Sree Patel
Director, IT Risk & Compliance
Mediconix

Ava / Rishi —

Quick internal note before we respond to Mediconix:

- Notification SLA: Redwood's standard hosted offering commits to initial customer notification within 48 hours of confirmed security incidents that materially affect customer data confidentiality or integrity. For Private deployments / on-prem we can align to customer SLAs in the contract — we should offer a 24–72 hour window depending on severity.
- Forensics packet: we have a standard post-incident evidence bundle (logs, timeline, containment actions, root-cause analysis) — I suggest we attach a sanitized example to the questionnaire response.
- HIPAA / BAA: legal has a BAA template; procurement asks often want to see it earlier. I'll pull the most recent BAA PDF and the SOC 2 Type II cover page for redaction.

I'll prepare two files to send with our completed VSQ: (1) sanitized sample forensics packet, (2) BAA template + SOC 2 cover page. Also propose Tuesday 2026-09-15 14:00 PT for the technical deep-dive (include Anika). Ava, can you confirm and create the calendar invite?

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

Thanks Sree — copying Anika and Procurement. 

We can confirm the following now: 
- Redwood initial customer notification window for hosted is 48 hours for confirmed incidents; for Private deployments we are contractually flexible (we'll include options in the BAA/contract).
- We will share a sanitized forensics example and SOC 2 cover page with the completed VSQ. Ben will attach the BAA template.
- Proposed tech deep-dive: Tuesday, 2026-09-15 at 14:00 PT (30 minutes). I've placed a tentative invite on all calendars; please accept or propose an alternate.

ACTIONS (owner / ETA):
- Mediconix: send VSQ to procurement@mediconix.com (Sree) — ETA 2026-09-10 EOD (open)
- Redwood (Ben): assemble sanitized forensics packet + BAA + SOC2 cover page — ETA 2026-09-12 EOD
- Redwood (Ava): finalize calendar invite & Mx action plan in HubSpot — ETA 2026-09-11 noon PT

If Anika or security@mediconix.com needs additional artifacts (key management, HSM attestations, or DR runbooks), flag here and we'll prioritize.

Best,
Ava
